current_prompt.body:
READ the authentication system specification:
- users register with email and password
- users login with email and password and receive a JWT
- JWT included in the Authorization header for all subsequent requests
- admins can view all users
- users can view only their own profile
IDENTIFY at least 7 missing security or usability requirements for the described system
LIST each identified requirement as a separate bullet point

current_plan.body:
READ the authentication system specification
ANALYZE the specification for missing security requirements
ANALYZE the specification for missing usability requirements
IDENTIFY at least seven missing requirements covering security and usability
FOR each identified requirement
    FORMULATE a concise bullet point description
EMIT the list of bullet points as the response
